name: Schwarzritter
source:
A swordswoman who was controlled by a cruel fate. Her demonic sword, Svafrlami, is able to cut through anything twice. However, the third time will bring her to ruin. To Satomura Momiji, her appearance reminds her of her best friend, Suzushiro Nagisa, more than anyone else.

[Translated From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=776568]Getchu[/url]]
